response.sql: WITH rating_counts AS (SELECT f.rating, COUNT(DISTINCT f.film_id) as film_count FROM rental r JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id JOIN film f ON i.film_id = f.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), total_count AS (SELECT SUM(film_count) as total FROM rating_counts), shares AS (SELECT rc.rating, rc.film_count, rc.film_count / t.total as share FROM rating_counts rc CROSS JOIN total_count t), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_value FROM shares), filtered_shares AS (SELECT s.rating, s.film_count, s.share, a.avg_share_value FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_share_value) SELECT SUM(film_count) as total_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(share - avg_share_value) as avg_excess FROM filtered_shares
